title: Generalized Weighted EP Elements in Banach Algebras
content: We pioneered a new class of generalized inverses, termed generalized weighted EP elements, unifying the concepts of weighted EP and *-DMP elements within Banach *-algebras. This framework allows us to establish a novel characterization of Banach elements expressible as the sum of a weighted EP element and a quasinilpotent. Furthermore, we derive distinct characterizations of weighted *-DMP elements, uncovering previously unknown properties of DMP elements.
